gmmpackSchema.description: Full semver. Major MUST be 1 for this schema document. A loader encountering any other major must refuse the archive outright, not attempt to validate against this schema.

id.description: Immutable pack identity, assigned once at first export, unchanged across every future revision.

revision.description: Strictly increasing per pack id. The installer treats revision <= its own installed revision as a no-op/refusal, not a downgrade.

gmmGameId.description: GMM's own canonical game id, NOT a per-provider slug/appid. Resolver looks up provider-specific ids from this via GMM's internal game catalog.

tools.description: External prerequisite software the pack expects to exist (e.g. LOOT). Advisory only, never bundled or auto-installed.

platform.description: Pack-wide platform defaults. Per-mod/per-executable overrides live in those items' own files, not here.

rules.description: Install-sequencing and dependency graph. References stable mod/executable ids only, never filenames or regex expressions -- this is what keeps rule matching case-sensitivity-agnostic across platforms.

pluginHint.description: Weak tiebreak only. LOOT's own masterlist-derived constraints always take precedence; this only resolves ties LOOT leaves open.

instanceSettings.description: Default-profile instance settings captured at export (profiles[0] flags + snapshot deploy strategy). Optional for backward compatibility with packs exported before per-instance settings existed.

fileHashes.description: Every other file in the archive (mods/*.json, executables/*.json, patches/*.json, ini/*.json, tree.json, instructions.md if present), keyed by archive-relative path. Validated FIRST, before any JSON in those files is even parsed.

protonVersionPin.description: Advisory. Missing build on the target system is a diagnostic warning, never a hard install failure.

steamOverlay.description: Maps directly onto GMM's existing LaunchParams.inject_steam_overlay -- do not introduce a parallel mechanism.
